tasks.title: THE CLEAREST CONTRADICTION
tasks.prompt: What is the clearest contradiction in the first set of records?

options.text: The QR code belongs to a second team.
Team Orbit’s received invitation says 4:30 PM, while the signed master run sheet says 4:00 PM.
Rohan changed Team Orbit’s check-in to 4:30 PM.
The check-in desk disqualified Team Orbit.

tasks.explanation: The received invitation says 4:30 PM while the signed run sheet says 4:00 PM.
reference_sql: select evidence_id, title from evidence_phase_1 where evidence_id in ('E01', 'E02', 'E03') order by evidence_id

tasks.title: WHAT THE DUTY BOARD SHOWS
tasks.prompt: What can the duty board establish at this stage?

options.text: It identifies who had roles near the invitation and printer workflow, but does not prove who produced the altered copy.
It proves Irfan changed the invitation.
It proves Aanya never approached the printer.
It proves Team Orbit changed its own invitation.

tasks.explanation: The board shows roles and times, not who produced the altered copy.
reference_sql: select evidence_id, title from evidence_phase_1 where evidence_id in ('E04') order by evidence_id

tasks.title: THE OFFICIAL EMAIL
tasks.prompt: What does the official email archive tell you about the version Team Orbit was originally sent?

options.text: The official attachment contained 4:30 PM.
The email was never delivered.
The archived attachment contained 4:00 PM and QR ORB-041.
The QR code was invalid.

tasks.explanation: The archived attachment says 4:00 PM and QR ORB-041.
reference_sql: select evidence_id, title from evidence_phase_2 where evidence_id in ('E05') order by evidence_id

tasks.title: PRINT QUEUE AND PHOTO
tasks.prompt: Which conclusion is justified by the print queue and photograph together?

options.text: An ANAIR-account print occurred at 3:51 PM, and Aanya is photographed collecting a sheet at the printer; neither record alone proves the sheet’s content.
The print queue proves Aanya personally typed every word.
The photograph proves the sheet was the official master run sheet.
Irfan must have altered the invitation because he was assigned to the printer.

tasks.explanation: An ANAIR print at 3:51 and Aanya at the tray at 3:54 together, with neither proving the page content alone.
reference_sql: select evidence_id, title from evidence_phase_2 where evidence_id in ('E06', 'E08') order by evidence_id

tasks.title: THE REJECTED PROOF
tasks.prompt: Why is the rejected proof important?

options.text: It proves Team Nova requested the change.
It proves the QR code created a duplicate registration.
It proves Rohan altered the master schedule.
It links the 4:30 PM Orbit copy and reused QR to a discarded proof marked “duplicate QR OK” in handwriting consistent with Aanya’s shift note.

tasks.explanation: The proof carries the wrong time and reused QR plus a note consistent with Aanya's shift note.
reference_sql: select evidence_id, title from evidence_phase_3 where evidence_id in ('E09', 'E10') order by evidence_id

tasks.title: THE BEST EXPLANATION
tasks.prompt: Which explanation best accounts for the complete evidence set?

options.text: Rohan accidentally changed Orbit’s check-in in the master schedule, and the printed invitation copied that change.
Aanya deliberately produced a 4:30 PM copy using Orbit’s existing QR, intending to delay Orbit past sound check so Nova would keep the first demo slot; she left the master schedule unchanged.
Meera altered her own invitation after arriving late.
Irfan created a second Orbit registration, which caused the time mismatch.

tasks.explanation: Only option B accounts for the wrong copy, the unchanged master, the reused QR and the stated motive.
reference_sql: select evidence_id, title from evidence_phase_2 where evidence_id in ('E05', 'E06', 'E08') order by evidence_id
select evidence_id, title from evidence_phase_3 where evidence_id in ('E09', 'E10') order by evidence_id
